messages:
ben (acme-dev): hey @alice we're seeing 401 invalid_api_key across prod calls since 09:03 UTC. No recent deploys, but we rotated a project key this morning via the dashboard.

alice (support): hi Ben — can you paste a sanitized curl + response you get? also which key id did you rotate?

ben (acme-dev): curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer RO-abcdef123' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"The provided API key is not valid."}
We tried with the old key and the new key id rk_45ART (rotated at 08:58). Both return 401.

alice (support): odd. Does the dashboard show rk_45ART as active? is it a project-level key or org-level? I'll check internal logs.

ben (acme-dev): Dashboard shows id rk_45ART status: active, scopes: embed:read,generate:write, type: project. It also shows "SSO-linked: acme.okta.com" which surprised us. SDK uses RO- prefix for read-only but we also tried the raw secret without the RO- prefix and still got 401.

claire (sre): pinging eng-infra. Quick thought: if a key is SSO-provisioned it can be temporarily disabled for programmatic use if the SSO sync marks the session unlinked. Ben, does the dashboard flag this as "SSO-provisioned"?

ben (acme-dev): yes it shows SSO-linked. We never turned on SSO for programmatic keys explicitly.

alice (support): pulled internal audit: at 09:02 UTC there is an entry: token_validation: key_revoked_by_sso_policy for rk_45ART coming from sso-sync service. Raising priority now. @claire can infra confirm whether sso-sync had failures for the acme tenant around 09:00?

claire (sre): checking logs... we had a scheduled background SSO entitlement sync at 08:59 that hit a timeout against acme.okta.com in eu-west-1. The reconciliation job marked programmatic access false during the transient error, and retry logic later re-evaluated but did not immediately flip the flag back. I'll intervene and manually clear the programmatic_disable flag and force a reconciliation.

deploy-bot: incident-12345 created: infra/sso-sync-failure - severity: high - assigned: eng-infra

alice (support): Ben can you retry now? I toggled the programmatic flag back and forced a reconcile for that key.

ben (acme-dev): retrying... 
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer RO-abcdef123' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"data": [ ... embeddings ... ] }
:tada: Works now from our EU worker. Huge thanks.

alice (support): marking resolved for now but keeping thread open for postmortem. Filing SUP-2149 to track follow-up and action items (make sso-sync idempotent and avoid transient revoke).

claire (sre): will follow up with a short postmortem and a fix to avoid flipping programmatic access during a partial outage. Thanks for quick repro steps, Ben.

ben (acme-dev): appreciate the quick turnaround, please cc our security team on the postmortem.
